title: Zetta-Joule mission + pinned video
description: A statement row (letter-by-letter label, big light statement, button), then a small paragraph beside a 6px-radius video frame. On desktop the frame is pinned and grows to fill the whole window while you scroll, and a dictionary-style definition fades up over it. On phones the video is a full-bleed 390×488 block with the definition over its lower half.
notes: the expanding video part is desktop only (lg+); it needs CSS scroll-driven animation, otherwise (and with reduced motion) the video stays a framed block
the media slot fills the frame: pass an img or video; with nothing passed, a placeholder shows
the video area forces the dark colour scope so the overlay text stays white
name: zetta-joule-mission
